mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment (PAYEMS) above 140,000 triggers optimism about labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when PAYEMS crosses above 140,000, or no correlation with employment growth.

mechanism_narrative: Joint increase in GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (industrial production) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies rise, or interaction effect rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals expected higher rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% in tightening regime, or p > 0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: An upward movement in the INDPRO supply index above 105.0 signals lower inflation expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when INDPRO rises, or no correlation detected.

mechanism_narrative: Surging demand measured by RSAFS exceeding 450,000 triggers positive S&P 500 returns within 20 days as investors anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when RSAFS crosses above 450,000, or p > 0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in UNRATE below 5.8% and rise in PAYEMS above 140,000 indicate a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies move as specified, or interaction effect rank IC <0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a drop in INDPRO below 105.0 signals potential inflation concerns, prompting positive S&P 500 returns within 20 days as investors anticipate rate hikes.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when INDPRO drops below 105.0 in late-cycle regime, or p >0.05 in t-test.
